definitions.gloss: desperate, reckless, throwing caution to the wind
definitions.explanation: An attitude of not caring about consequences anymore, often because one has given up hope. Acting recklessly out of desperation or resignation.

examples.japanese: {捨|す}て{鉢|ばち}な⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: To take a reckless, defiant attitude.

examples.japanese: {捨|す}て{鉢|ばち}になって⟦{全部|ぜんぶ}→全部：02888_zenbu⟧⟦やめて→やめる：00909_yameru⟧しまった。
⟦どんな→どんな：02924_donna⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{辛|つら}くて→辛い：01112_tsurai⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、{捨|す}て{鉢|ばち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ならないで→なる：01970_naru⟧ほしい。
examples.english: No matter how hard it is, I don't want you to give up and act recklessly.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
- {捨|す}て{鉢|ばち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become desperate/reckless
- {捨|す}て{鉢|ばち}な⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧: a defiant, don't-care attitude
- {捨|す}て{鉢|ばち}な{気持|きも}ち: a feeling of desperation

ETYMOLOGY:
Literally "thrown-away bowl" — from a Buddhist begging bowl (⟦{鉢|はち}→鉢：29581_hachi⟧). Throwing away the bowl symbolizes abandoning all discipline and restraint.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦やけくそ→やけくそ：09376_yakekuso⟧: reckless abandon (more colloquial)
- ⟦{自暴自棄|じぼうじき}→自暴自棄：06147_jiboujiki⟧: desperation, giving up on oneself (more formal)
